modes.iq_only: One concurrent worker per RX node invokes the live-tested ChannelProcessor::process_superposition with cached readonly IQ. No sockets, PHY, MAC or per-output power scan on its critical path. Same CUDA backend object files.
modes.radio_zmq_only: Synthetic per-radio cf32 peers (one ZMQ context per radio, TX REP/RX REQ sockets per port) exchange IQ with the live-tested broker. This is not OCUDU radio_zmq class or srsUE RF code; it measures synthetic raw-IQ transport, not native radio implementation or PHY/MAC.

channel.model: Static deterministic8-tap TDL with receiver AWGN
channel.cells: independent, no inter-cell edges; one broker instance
channel.live_difference: Live stack uses frozen moving Sionna channel updates; current isolation sweep keeps a static common channel in both modes.

axes.ue_count: 1cell,20MHz,1x1; powers through64, extend passing upper bounds and refine integer bracket
axes.bandwidth: 4UEs,1cell,1x1;20/50/100MHz use23.04/61.44/122.88MS/s and1/1/0.5ms batches. Bandwidth is represented by the corresponding live-radio IQ workload, not a separate channel-emulator MHz parameter.
axes.ports: 1UE,1cell,20MHz; raw symmetric channel-matrix port counts, not NR spatial layers or a live-stack antenna capability claim.

timing.iq_pacing: absolute deadlines with unbounded catch-up (no radio buffers); report late completions separately
timing.radio_pacing: shipping broker bounded catch-up; cached peers do not add their own rate cap
timing.cadence_gate: All receivers complete at least floor(measure_duration/batch_duration)-1 batches; the single-batch uncertainty comes from counting periodic publications in a finite common wall window.
timing.strict_gate: No IQ completion after its slot deadline; for radio, zero producer pacing rebases and zero channel calls longer than the batch period; health required.
timing.clarification: Cadence coverage is not a packet-success rate or a guarantee of zero deadline misses; detailed exact ratios/miss counts are retained.
timing.startup: Certified IQ results wait until every RX worker completes a real first CUDA call before opening the common warmup/measurement schedule. Radio captures were audited: every port had produced IQ by heartbeat2, before the common measurement window.

measurement_changes: Broker counters accumulate in memory, read the epoch file only in its20ms control loop before measurement, and write summaries after producer shutdown. Backend and pacing logic are unchanged.
Cached peer sine cycles were wire-compared to the existing per-sample trigonometric generator across24messages at23040/61440sample sizes:16,220,160bytes identical.
IQ workers maintain private timing/count arrays, avoiding the old benchmark shared accounting mutex and shared last_timings phase attribution.
Process CPU usage is not synonymous with arithmetic time; CUDA runtime work and CPU waiting may consume CPU time.
limits: Finite-duration, placement-dependent whole-host results; not an architecture-independent GPU maximum.
Synthetic peer and IQ harness input patterns differ; byte sizes, topology and8-tap model work are matched, with reused host buffers on both sides.
The new source cache removes historical dummy sine-generation CPU cost; old radio-only boundaries therefore are historical references, not identical harness results.
Reference64UE claims must distinguish single gNB fan-in call latency from all-node throughput and deadline coverage.
excluded: Initial timer-only IQ runs are retained as preflight evidence, not used for final boundaries; the fixed200ms startup signal did not certify all workers had initialized.
additional_controls: 64UE IQ checked3times using all fast cores: RTX P0-7 and Spark X9255-9,15-19.
Transport counters disabled for observed UE boundary sides and16UE; same broker executable and5-core allocation.
Bandwidth50/100MHz and conservative lower-load points repeated.
